name: Build ELLEITHY MANAGER APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Accept SDK licenses
        run: yes | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --licenses || true

      - name: Install Android SDK
        run: "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0"

      - name: Set up Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.9'

      - name: Extract project
        run: |
          if [ -f FleetManagerPro_MultiPlatform.zip ]; then
            unzip -o FleetManagerPro_MultiPlatform.zip -d extracted
          elif [ -f FleetManagerPro_Android.zip ]; then
            unzip -o FleetManagerPro_Android.zip -d extracted
          else
            echo "ERROR: No Android ZIP found."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Find Android project
        id: project
        run: |
          SETTINGS=$(find extracted -type f \( -name settings.gradle -o -name settings.gradle.kts \) -print -quit)
          if [ -z "$SETTINGS" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: No settings.gradle found in ZIP."
            find extracted -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -80
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "dir=$(dirname "$SETTINGS")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Build APK
        run: gradle -p "${{ steps.project.outputs.dir }}" assembleDebug

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ELLEITHY-MANAGER-APK
          path: extracted/**/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
